description: The engine toolsets boopis switches on and off for a bot, once, when it makes the bot and once for every bot made before this list (ADR-0047). A toolset in neither list is left as the engine has it (a plugin's toolset, an MCP server, a toolset the engine leaves off). The same set applies to the bot's chats, its `boopis run --bot` runs, its kanban workers and its group-room turns. A toolset the owner switches on later stays on: boopis does not apply the list to that bot again. The owner chooses what is in these lists.

on.name: file
on.why: Reading and writing the project's files: every Paper Past bot does.

on.name: terminal
on.why: Running the project's commands (uv run shorts.py, ffmpeg, capture.py).

on.name: web
on.why: Search and fetch: research and fact-checks with sources.

on.name: vision
on.why: Looking at stills and contact sheets (QA, renders, scenes).

on.name: skills
on.why: Without it a bot sees no skills at all, the hand-off skill and the default skill index included.

on.name: memory
on.why: A bot keeps its own memory across sessions.

on.name: todo
on.why: Planning a task of several steps.

on.name: clarify
on.why: Asking the owner a question instead of guessing.

off.name: kanban
off.why: On only for a bot on a board (below): 15 tools, the largest toolset.

off.name: browser
off.why: Driving a browser; a bot that renders pages runs its own script in the terminal.

off.name: delegation
off.why: Starting subagents; a bot hands work to teammates on the board instead.

off.name: code_execution
off.why: The engine's code kernel; the terminal covers a bot's scripts.

off.name: connections
off.why: Remote connectors and account sign-ins; connectors are added in Settings.

off.name: cronjob
off.why: A bot changing its own schedule; the owner sets it in the bot's settings.

off.name: tts
off.why: Speech; a bot that voices videos runs the project's own tool.

on.name: kanban
on.why: A bot on a board files, links and comments on cards from its room and its chats. A kanban worker has these tools whatever this says: the engine adds them to the card's session.
